name: context-saver
description: Keeps Claude Code sessions light: a line above the prompt with context and usage, a heads-up and an automatic compaction before the window fills, a stop on reading huge files whole, and long shell output cut to its head and tail with the full text kept on disk.

warnAt.title: Heads-up at (%)
warnAt.description: Context fill at which a one-time notice suggests a handoff. 0 turns it off.

compactAt.title: Compact at (%)
compactAt.description: Context fill at which the session is compacted once, keeping decisions, open work and pitfalls. 0 turns it off.

maxReadLines.title: Largest whole-file read (lines)
maxReadLines.description: A Read without offset or limit on a text file longer than this is refused with a hint to read a range or search. 0 turns it off.

maxOutputLines.title: Longest shell output (lines)
maxOutputLines.description: Bash and PowerShell output longer than this is cut to its first 150 and last 50 lines; the full text is saved and its path shown. 0 turns it off.
